descripcion: A password manager that supports Bitwarden platform and KeePass (KDBX) files. It autofills your logins, supports passkeys, works offline, and runs a Watchtower that finds leaked and reused passwords and other issues.

evidencia.nota: hash del JSON exacto devuelto por la API en la fecha declarada

fuente.metodo: GET /repos, /releases/latest, /license y /commits?per_page=1 con token; payload sellado
